english_text: Mr President , I would like to give an explanation of my negative vote on the report on the European Year of Languages . Firstly , language occupies an important place in European civilisation and culture , irrespective of numerical considerations regarding the size of the population . This statement is thoroughly valid for lesser-used languages . Secondly , the target year for this decision is 2001 ; European citizens could become proficient in other languages as is shown by the fact that all people who speak minority languages , without exception , have in common an excellent training in this field . All of them are already bilingual . It is completely wrong to exclude minority languages from this initiative . It is regrettable that this House has not accepted the important services that lesser-used languages could contribute to the success of this initiative .
